standards.summaryText: Express ideas and develop understanding: extend understanding of ideas and information by finding and exploring oral, print and other media texts on related topics and themes; express personal understandings of ideas and information based on prior knowledge, experiences with others and a variety of oral, print and other media texts; reflect on own observations and experiences to understand and develop oral, print and other media texts
standards.officialOutcomeText: Express ideas and develop understanding: extend understanding of ideas and information by finding and exploring oral, print and other media texts on related topics and themes; express personal understandings of ideas and information based on prior knowledge, experiences with others and a variety of oral, print and other media texts; reflect on own observations and experiences to understand and develop oral, print and other media texts
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to express ideas and develop understanding.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA7 > General Outcome 1 > 1.1 Discover and Explore > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Experiment with language and forms: discuss and respond to ways that content and forms of oral, print and other media texts interact to influence understanding
standards.officialOutcomeText: Experiment with language and forms: discuss and respond to ways that content and forms of oral, print and other media texts interact to influence understanding
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to experiment with language and forms.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA7 > General Outcome 1 > 1.1 Discover and Explore > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Express preferences: explore and assess oral, print and other media texts recommended by others
standards.officialOutcomeText: Express preferences: explore and assess oral, print and other media texts recommended by others
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to express preferences.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA7 > General Outcome 1 > 1.1 Discover and Explore > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Set goals: use appropriate terminology to discuss developing abilities in personal language learning and use
standards.officialOutcomeText: Set goals: use appropriate terminology to discuss developing abilities in personal language learning and use
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to set goals.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA7 > General Outcome 1 > 1.1 Discover and Explore > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Consider the ideas of others: listen and respond constructively to alternative ideas or opinions
standards.officialOutcomeText: Consider the ideas of others: listen and respond constructively to alternative ideas or opinions
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to consider the ideas of others.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA7 > General Outcome 1 > 1.2 Clarify and Extend > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Combine ideas: use talk, writing and representing to examine, clarify and assess understanding of ideas, information and experiences
standards.officialOutcomeText: Combine ideas: use talk, writing and representing to examine, clarify and assess understanding of ideas, information and experiences
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to combine ideas.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA7 > General Outcome 1 > 1.2 Clarify and Extend > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Extend understanding: talk with others to elaborate ideas, and ask specific questions to seek helpful feedback
standards.officialOutcomeText: Extend understanding: talk with others to elaborate ideas, and ask specific questions to seek helpful feedback
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to extend understanding.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA7 > General Outcome 1 > 1.2 Clarify and Extend > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Use prior knowledge: select and focus relevant ideas from personal experiences and prior knowledge to understand new ideas and information; use expectations and preferences developed during previous reading experiences to select and read new texts with purpose
standards.officialOutcomeText: Use prior knowledge: select and focus relevant ideas from personal experiences and prior knowledge to understand new ideas and information; use expectations and preferences developed during previous reading experiences to select and read new texts with purpose
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to use prior knowledge.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA7 > General Outcome 2 > 2.1 Use Strategies and Cues > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Use comprehension strategies: identify, connect, and summarize in own words, the main ideas from two or more sources on the same topic; use concept mapping and mental rehearsal to remember main ideas and relevant details; adjust reading rate and strategies to account for changes in structural features of texts and complexity of content
standards.officialOutcomeText: Use comprehension strategies: identify, connect, and summarize in own words, the main ideas from two or more sources on the same topic; use concept mapping and mental rehearsal to remember main ideas and relevant details; adjust reading rate and strategies to account for changes in structural features of texts and complexity of content
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to use comprehension strategies.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA7 > General Outcome 2 > 2.1 Use Strategies and Cues > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Use textual cues: identify and use visual and textual cues, such as numbers, bullets and words; for example, first/then/next, before/after, on the one hand/on the other hand and if/then, that signal organizational patterns in print and other media texts, to enhance understanding of ideas and information; identify and use, effectively and efficiently, structural features of textbooks, such as tables of contents and indices, to access ideas and nformation and to read with purpose
standards.officialOutcomeText: Use textual cues: identify and use visual and textual cues, such as numbers, bullets and words; for example, first/then/next, before/after, on the one hand/on the other hand and if/then, that signal organizational patterns in print and other media texts, to enhance understanding of ideas and information; identify and use, effectively and efficiently, structural features of textbooks, such as tables of contents and indices, to access ideas and nformation and to read with purpose
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to use textual cues.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA7 > General Outcome 2 > 2.1 Use Strategies and Cues > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Use phonics and structural analysis: apply, flexibly, knowledge of phonics, sight vocabulary, structural analysis, language and context clues, depending on the purpose and rate of reading
standards.officialOutcomeText: Use phonics and structural analysis: apply, flexibly, knowledge of phonics, sight vocabulary, structural analysis, language and context clues, depending on the purpose and rate of reading
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to use phonics and structural analysis.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA7 > General Outcome 2 > 2.1 Use Strategies and Cues > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Use references: skim and scan reference materials to confirm the spellings or locate the meanings of unfamiliar words
standards.officialOutcomeText: Use references: skim and scan reference materials to confirm the spellings or locate the meanings of unfamiliar words
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to use references.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA7 > General Outcome 2 > 2.1 Use Strategies and Cues > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Experience various texts: experience oral, print and other media texts from a variety of cultural traditions and genres, such as journals, nature programs, short stories, poetry, letters, CDROM programs, mysteries, historical fiction, drawings and prints; justify own point of view about oral, print and other media texts, using evidence from texts; organize interpretations of oral, print and other media texts around two or three key ideas; express interpretations of oral, print and other media texts in another form or genre; predict and discuss the consequences of events or characters' actions, based on information in oral, print and other media texts
standards.officialOutcomeText: Experience various texts: experience oral, print and other media texts from a variety of cultural traditions and genres, such as journals, nature programs, short stories, poetry, letters, CDROM programs, mysteries, historical fiction, drawings and prints; justify own point of view about oral, print and other media texts, using evidence from texts; organize interpretations of oral, print and other media texts around two or three key ideas; express interpretations of oral, print and other media texts in another form or genre; predict and discuss the consequences of events or characters' actions, based on information in oral, print and other media texts
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to experience various texts.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA7 > General Outcome 2 > 2.2 Respond to Texts > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Construct meaning from texts: compare the choices and behaviours of characters portrayed in oral, print and other media texts with those of self and others; analyze how plot develops; the connection between plot and subplot; and the interrelationship of plot, setting and characters; identify and explain conflict, and discuss how it develops and may be resolved; develop, clarify and defend own interpretation, based on evidence from the text with support from own experiences
standards.officialOutcomeText: Construct meaning from texts: compare the choices and behaviours of characters portrayed in oral, print and other media texts with those of self and others; analyze how plot develops; the connection between plot and subplot; and the interrelationship of plot, setting and characters; identify and explain conflict, and discuss how it develops and may be resolved; develop, clarify and defend own interpretation, based on evidence from the text with support from own experiences
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to construct meaning from texts.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA7 > General Outcome 2 > 2.2 Respond to Texts > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Appreciate the artistry of texts: discuss how techniques, such as colour, shape, composition, suspense, foreshadowing and flashback, are used to communicate meaning and enhance effects in oral, print and other media texts; identify and explain the usefulness, effectiveness and limitations of various forms of oral, print and other media texts; reflect on, revise and elaborate on initial impressions of oral, print and other media texts, through subsequent reading, listening and viewing activities
standards.officialOutcomeText: Appreciate the artistry of texts: discuss how techniques, such as colour, shape, composition, suspense, foreshadowing and flashback, are used to communicate meaning and enhance effects in oral, print and other media texts; identify and explain the usefulness, effectiveness and limitations of various forms of oral, print and other media texts; reflect on, revise and elaborate on initial impressions of oral, print and other media texts, through subsequent reading, listening and viewing activities
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to appreciate the artistry of texts.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA7 > General Outcome 2 > 2.2 Respond to Texts > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Understand forms and genres: identify various forms and genres of oral, print and other media texts, and describe key characteristics of each; identify the characteristics of different types of media texts
standards.officialOutcomeText: Understand forms and genres: identify various forms and genres of oral, print and other media texts, and describe key characteristics of each; identify the characteristics of different types of media texts
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to understand forms and genres.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA7 > General Outcome 2 > 2.3 Understand Forms, Elements and Techniques > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Understand techniques and elements: discuss connections among plot and subplot, main and supporting characters, main idea and theme in a variety of oral, print and other media texts; identify the narrator's perspective, and explain how it affects the overall meaning of a text; identify and explain how narrative hooks, foreshadowing, flashback, suspense and surprise endings contribute to the effectiveness of plot development; explain how sound and image work together to create effects in media texts
standards.officialOutcomeText: Understand techniques and elements: discuss connections among plot and subplot, main and supporting characters, main idea and theme in a variety of oral, print and other media texts; identify the narrator's perspective, and explain how it affects the overall meaning of a text; identify and explain how narrative hooks, foreshadowing, flashback, suspense and surprise endings contribute to the effectiveness of plot development; explain how sound and image work together to create effects in media texts
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to understand techniques and elements.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA7 > General Outcome 2 > 2.3 Understand Forms, Elements and Techniques > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Experiment with language: explore surprising and playful uses of language and visuals in popular culture, such as cartoons, animated films and limericks; explain ways in which imagery and figurative language, such as simile, convey meaning
standards.officialOutcomeText: Experiment with language: explore surprising and playful uses of language and visuals in popular culture, such as cartoons, animated films and limericks; explain ways in which imagery and figurative language, such as simile, convey meaning
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to experiment with language.
